name: Maliya–Dandi Highway
aka: Southern section was the former NH 228 (old numbering)
history: NH 64 joins two very different corners of Gujarat: the salt flats near Maliya at the edge of the Little Rann of Kutch, and the seaside village of Dandi, where Mahatma Gandhi's Salt March ended in 1930. From Maliya it runs east through Dhrangadhra and Viramgam to Ahmedabad, then turns south as the Dandi Heritage Route, roughly following the path of the march through Kheda, Anand, Bharuch, Surat and Navsari to the sea, crossing the Mahi river near Vadodara on the way.
facts: Its southern section retraces Mahatma Gandhi's famous 1930 Salt March from the Ahmedabad area to Dandi.
Ends at Dandi beach, where the Salt March finished on 6 April 1930.
Crosses the Narmada river at Bharuch, near the historic Golden Bridge.
About 528 km long, entirely within Gujarat.
